name: Sofitel Kia Ora Moorea Beach Resort
desc: The Sofitel Kia Ora Moorea Beach Resort reopened its doors in 2026 following a complete renovation of its common areas and overwater villas. The property is located on the shore of a magnificent lagoon with views of the island of Tahiti. The resort comprises 110 luxurious villas built over the water, along the beach, or nestled among landscaped gardens.
